definition.content: ADR-0084 decomposes AuthZ latency before optimization. Enable Datadog percentile aggregations for temper_cedar_evaluation_duration, temper_cedar_evaluation_duration_ms, and temper_cedar_evaluation_phase_duration_ms before treating p95/p99 widgets or monitors as live gates. The avg/max fallback panels remain useful until that metric configuration lands.

definition.content: Trace budget policy keeps canonical request roots and reduces noisy helper spans. `wasm_auxiliary` defaults to 5% and `dispatch_background` defaults to 25%. Raise `TEMPER_TRACE_WASM_AUX_SAMPLE_PCT` or `TEMPER_TRACE_DISPATCH_BACKGROUND_SAMPLE_PCT` temporarily during incidents when child-span detail matters more than trace volume.

Profiles are captured on-demand via `GET /_admin/profile/cpu?seconds=N` and `GET /_admin/profile/wall?seconds=N`. Enable with `TEMPER_PROFILING_ENABLED=true`, auto-upload with `TEMPER_PROFILING_AUTO_UPLOAD=true`. Jump to APM → Profiles for flame graphs.
